description: Golden questions for catalog retrieval evaluation. Each question names the SDK method(s) a competent assistant must retrieve. 'category': keyword = terms should match the current index; paraphrase = natural Vietnamese rewording (the WP8 watch set); boundary = discriminative between similar tools. The deterministic harness (catalog/eval_test.go) runs this in CI; tools/catalog-eval runs it through a live model for tool-selection rate (WP7 instrument).
